cards.name: IDBI Royale Signature
cards.welcome_benefit: 750 Delight Points on first transaction of Rs.1,500+ within 30 days of activation (400 points if between 31-90 days).
cards.lounge_access: 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit per quarter (Visa domestic lounge programme). No international lounge access.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-4,000, capped at Rs.500.
cards.eligibility: Salaried 21-60 yrs, self-employed 21-65 yrs, Indian resident. Income criteria not published.
cards.notes: IDBI's flagship retail card; currently offered lifetime free. 3 Delight Points/Rs.100 headline rate is marketed for travel/shopping/dining/movies spend. Redemption 1 DP = Rs.0.25. IDBI also offers Aspire Platinum (entry, 2 pts/Rs.150), Euphoria World and secured Imperium variants.

cards.name: Union Bank RuPay Select
cards.lounge_access: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits per quarter (8/year) and 2 international visits per year (RuPay Select programme).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver, capped at Rs.100 per billing cycle.
cards.eligibility: Published criteria sparse; bank asks applicants to check eligibility via its card portal.
cards.notes: Effective ~1% reward rate (4 pts/Rs.100 at Rs.0.25/pt). Points valid 3 years. UPI-linkable RuPay credit card. Union Bank also issues RuPay Platinum, Visa Gold/Signature and the UNI Carbon HPCL fuel co-brand.

cards.name: Canara Bank RuPay Select
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access under the RuPay Select programme (bank does not publish exact visit counts).
cards.eligibility: Existing Canara Bank relationship generally expected; published criteria sparse.
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Effective ~0.5% reward rate (2 pts/Rs.100 at Rs.0.25/pt); points valid 3 years. Up to 4 free add-on cards. Canara also issues RuPay Platinum and Visa Classic/Gold/World variants, mostly no-fee.

cards.name: Bank of India RuPay Platinum
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access at select lounges under the RuPay Platinum programme.
cards.eligibility: Published criteria sparse; typically requires BOI banking relationship.
cards.notes: Zero joining/annual fee. Marketed as 2X points on POS and online spends; third-party reports of point value vary (Rs.0.25-1) so rupee_per_point left null - verify on BOI Star Rewardz portal before relying on it. Includes Rs.2 lakh personal accident cover. BOI also issues Visa Gold International and Swadhan RuPay Platinum (secured) cards.

cards.name: Indian Bank RuPay Platinum (IB RuPay Platinum)
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access under the RuPay Platinum programme.
cards.eligibility: Published criteria sparse; typically requires Indian Bank relationship.
cards.notes: No joining fee; ~Rs.250 annual fee from year 2 (waiver terms not published). Reward earn rate and point value not published - left null. Indian Bank also issues Visa Global/Gold and Bharat variants, and is one of OneCard's issuing partner banks.

cards.name: IOB RuPay Select
cards.lounge_access: Lounge access per RuPay Select programme; bank does not publish visit counts.
cards.eligibility: Published criteria sparse; apply via IOB's dedicated credit card portal.
cards.notes: IOB re-entered the credit card business and now issues RuPay Classic/Select and Visa Classic/Gold; zero joining fee on all, RuPay Select renewal Rs.500 + taxes. Reward earn rate/point value not published - left null. Terms are sparse on official pages.

cards.name: UCO Bank SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 bonus points on spending Rs.2,000 within 60 days (standard SimplySAVE launch offer).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to UCO Bank customers (largely pre-approved base); underwritten by SBI Card on non-risk-participation basis.
cards.notes: Co-brand issued and serviced by SBI Card for UCO Bank customers; terms mirror the regular SBI SimplySAVE card (10X points on dining/movies/grocery/departmental stores). UCO Bank itself issues no standalone credit card. A UCO Bank SBI Card PRIME variant also exists.

cards.name: Central Bank of India RuPay Select
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 Croma gift voucher and Apollo Pharmacy discount coupon.
cards.lounge_access: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits per quarter; 4 international visits per year (RuPay Select programme).
cards.eligibility: 18-65 years; must hold an account with Central Bank of India.
cards.notes: 3 loyalty points/Rs.100 but point value not published - left null. 5% cashback on utility bills and on dining, each capped at Rs.50/month. Rs.10 lakh accidental death/disability cover (NPCI). Fee data from aggregator (BankBazaar); official pages are sparse - verify before import.

cards.name: Bank of Maharashtra SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to Bank of Maharashtra customers; underwritten by SBI Card.
cards.notes: 2025 co-brand launch in three variants: SimplySAVE (RuPay), PRIME and ELITE (Visa); terms mirror the equivalent SBI Cards. BoM also has an older self-issued Platinum RuPay Contactless credit card (low/no fee, sparse published terms).

cards.name: Karur Vysya (KVB) SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to KVB customers; underwritten by SBI Card.
cards.notes: KVB's only credit cards are SBI Card co-brands; terms mirror regular SBI SimplySAVE. Premium KVB SBI Platinum/Signature variants exist (Rs.2,999 fee, waiver at Rs.3 lakh spend).

cards.name: South Indian Bank SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to South Indian Bank customers; underwritten by SBI Card.
cards.notes: Terms mirror regular SBI SimplySAVE; annual fee waived at Rs.1 lakh annual spend. SIB SBI Card PRIME variant also available. South Indian Bank is additionally one of OneCard's issuing partner banks.

cards.name: TMB Wings (Tamilnad Mercantile Bank)
cards.eligibility: Indian citizens 21-65 years with annual income above Rs.3 lakh.
cards.notes: TMB's consumer RuPay credit card for everyday spends; marketed with no joining/annual fees, ~45-day interest-free period, limits Rs.20,000-5 lakh, personal accident cover Rs.5 lakh. Reward programme details not published - left null. TMB also offers the RuPay Phoenix business credit card. Official pages are very sparse.

cards.name: Karnataka Bank SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to Karnataka Bank customers; issued by SBI Card on non-risk-participation basis.
cards.notes: Karnataka Bank's credit cards are SBI Card co-brands in two variants: SimplySAVE and SBI Card PRIME (Rs.2,999 fee, waiver at Rs.3 lakh spend). Terms mirror the equivalent SBI Cards.

cards.name: DBS Vantage (DBS Bank India)
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome/renewal bonus of 10,000 Vantage Points on fee payment (if spend-based waiver not met); complimentary memberships bundled at launch.
cards.milestone_benefits: 5,000 bonus VP at Rs.3 lakh and 10,000 VP at Rs.5 lakh quarterly spend; 40,000 VP at Rs.20 lakh calendar-year spend. 10% cashback at airport duty-free stores, capped Rs.1,500/month.
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access (Visa Infinite programme); allowances vary by relationship tier.
cards.eligibility: Invite-only, targeted at affluent/DBS Treasures customers.
cards.notes: DBS Bank India's only consumer credit card (DBS absorbed Lakshmi Vilas Bank in 2020; no separate LVB cards remain). Earn rate 4 VP/Rs.200 domestic (=2/100), 8 VP/Rs.200 international. Fee is tiered by DBS relationship: Rs.10k (Elite), Rs.20k (Treasures), Rs.50k (others), all waived at Rs.10 lakh anniversary spend; catalog lists the lowest tier. Point value is redemption-dependent (best via air-mile transfers) - left null; marketed with a low forex markup, exact % not confirmed.

cards.name: CSB One Card (CSB Bank x OneCard)
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard OneCard exclusions (fuel, rent, wallet loads etc. per MITC).
cards.eligibility: App-based onboarding via OneCard app; CSB Bank is the issuing bank.
cards.notes: CSB Bank's first consumer credit card, co-branded with OneCard (FPL Technologies) and Mastercard; mobile-first, lifetime free, 1% forex markup. Earns 1 point/Rs.50 (=2/100) with 5X on top-2 monthly categories (needs spend in 3+ categories, min Rs.750 each). Point value ~Rs.0.10 - modest; note this is community-reported, not officially published.

cards.name: Dhanlaxmi Bank Platinum
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary airport lounge access advertised (visit counts not published).
cards.eligibility: Minimum income Rs.6 lakh p.a.; salaried or self-employed.
cards.notes: Dhanlaxmi's sole flagship card. Sources conflict on the renewal fee (lifetime free vs Rs.400/year) - annual_fee left null. 5% cashback categories modelled as merchant bonuses with rupee_per_point 1; base earn on other spends not published. Cashback caps not published. Interest 1.9% p.m. Verify with the bank before import.

cards.name: Saraswat Bank RuPay Platinum
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access under the RuPay Platinum programme.
cards.eligibility: Primarily for Saraswat Bank (urban co-operative bank) members/customers, Maharashtra-centric footprint.
cards.notes: One of the few co-operative-bank credit cards in India. Rs.500 annual fee waived on very low spend threshold (Rs.10,000/year). 1 point/Rs.100; point value not officially published - left null. Terms largely sourced from community reports (TechnoFino); official page is sparse.

cards.name: J&K Bank Eminent
cards.milestone_benefits: Rs.1,000 dining voucher on annual spends above Rs.6 lakh.
cards.lounge_access: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits per quarter; 1 international visit every 6 months.
cards.eligibility: Primarily J&K Bank customers; bank has a pan-India push but distribution is J&K-centric.
cards.notes: Top card of J&K Bank's 2024-revamped suite (Eminent > Platinum Privilege > Platinum). Earns 1 point per Rs.200 (=0.5/100), accrual in multiples of Rs.200; point value not published and points lapse after 1 year - weak rewards, lounge-led proposition. Platinum variant: Rs.500 fee, waiver at Rs.1 lakh; Platinum Privilege: no fee.

cards.name: Punjab & Sind Bank (PSB) SimplySAVE SBI Card
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-3,000 (standard SBI Card terms).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and other standard SBI Card exclusions earn no points.
cards.eligibility: Offered to Punjab & Sind Bank customers; underwritten by SBI Card.
cards.notes: Punjab & Sind Bank has no self-issued credit card; co-brand launched with SBI Card (Dec 2022/Jan 2023) in three variants - SimplySAVE (RuPay), PRIME and ELITE (Visa). Terms mirror the equivalent SBI Cards.

cards.name: OneCard (FPL Technologies)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver (per issuing-bank MITC; caps vary by partner).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads and EMI conversions typically earn no points (per MITC).
cards.eligibility: App-first onboarding; secured (FD-backed) variant available for thin-file users.
cards.notes: Fintech card by FPL Technologies issued via partner banks: Federal Bank, BOBCARD, SBM Bank India, South Indian Bank, CSB Bank and Indian Bank (network/terms vary slightly by issuer). Lifetime-free metal card, 1% forex markup, never-expiring points. Earns 1 pt/Rs.50 (=2/100); 5X on top-2 monthly categories requires spends in 3+ categories of Rs.750+ each. Point value ~Rs.0.10 (redeem against statement), so effective 0.2% base / 1% on 5X - low despite the 5X marketing.

cards.name: slice UPI Credit Card (Slice Small Finance Bank)
cards.eligibility: App-based onboarding via slice app; issued by Slice Small Finance Bank.
cards.notes: Status verified 2026: slice DOES still issue credit cards. After the old slice card was hit by RBI's 2022 PPI/credit-line rules, slice merged with North East Small Finance Bank (Oct 2024, renamed Slice SFB May 2025) and launched a UPI-linked RuPay credit card in June 2025 that it now issues as a regulated bank; it reports as an unsecured credit card on CIBIL. No joining/annual fee; cashback marketed as 'up to 3%' and offer-driven, so base rate left null - actual flat rate and caps are not clearly published. 'Slice in 3' splits spends into 3 interest-free instalments.
